newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker Maritime wins NOK 250 mln Hitachi deal.
newsitem.headline: Aker Maritime wins NOK 250 mln Hitachi deal.

text.p: Norwegian offshore group Aker Maritime ASA said on Monday it had been awarded a 250 million crown contract for a double RamRig drilling package by Japan's Hitachi Zosen Corp.
Aker Maritime said it also had signed with Hitachi a licence agreement to build RamRig units for the Japan and Korean markets.

The group's Maritime Hydraulics unit in Krisiansand clinched the RamRig deal. Hitachi will carry out fabrication, installation and testing of the drilling package in cooperation with Maritime Hydraulics.
The new rig will be used aboard the drilling platform West Future II, which Hitachi is constructing for Stavanger-based Smedvig ASA.
The rig is due to be completed in November, 1998, and will be used to drill on the North Sea Troll development from 1999 for operator Norsk Hydro ASA.
